messages:
claire: quick flag from this morning's legal-domain onboarding for lex-embed-int6: overall R@5 looks okay but R@10 and cluster purity for "case law" subset tanked. paste quick output.
claire: command I ran:
```
./onboard_embed --model=lex-embed-int6 --dataset=legal_holdout_2k --subset=case_law,contracts --k=1,5,10 --quant=per-tensor --whiten=global --batch=128
```
jordy: can you paste the table? short thread helps.
claire: table (avg 3 runs):
```
model         subset     R@1    R@5    R@10  purity
lex-fp16      case_law   0.378  0.661  0.723 0.68
lex-int6      case_law   0.371  0.654  0.662 0.41  <-- large R@10 & purity drop
lex-fp16      contracts  0.412  0.702  0.761 0.71
lex-int6      contracts  0.410  0.699  0.755 0.69
```
hamid: interesting that contracts unchanged but case_law collapsed. legal text has lots of section symbols, citations, and rare proper nouns. did you use the same tokenization/cleaning?
claire: yes same preprocessing. whitening was trained on a mixed legal dev set but case_law slices are heavy on Latin phrases and bracketed citations which are low-frequency.
jordy: heavy tail artifacts again maybe. can you dump L2 norm and top1-top3 cosine gap for case_law?
claire: pasted stats:
```
metric     model      subset     mean_norm  std_norm  top1-2_gap
L2         lex-fp16   case_law   12.0       2.0       0.115
L2         lex-int6   case_law   11.3       4.2       0.028  <-- narrow gap
```
bench-bot: queued two quick runs: (A) per-channel quant, (B) calibration sampling biased to rare legal tokens (stratified by token freq). run ids 6461200201 and 6461200302.
bench-bot: run 6461200201 finished: lex-int6-perchannel case_law R@10=0.715 purity=0.66 top1-2_gap=0.098
bench-bot: run 6461200302 finished: lex-int6-stratcalib case_law R@10=0.701 purity=0.60 top1-2_gap=0.075
hamid: per-channel nearly recovers fp16. stratified helps but not as much. suggests granularity of quant matters for legal tail tokens.
jordy: can we try per-channel + include case_law in whitening training? small AB.
claire: queued perchan+casewhiten run 6461200450.
bench-bot: run 6461200450 done: lex-int6-perchan-casewhiten R@10=0.719 purity=0.68 top1-2_gap=0.102 (almost identical to fp16). artifacts: /artifacts/6461200450/umap_case_law.png
hamid: root cause: rare token geometry + coarse per-tensor quant -> neighbor ordering scramble at mid ranks. mitigation: recommend onboarding checklist changes: (1) require subset-specific whitening sample for any heavy-tail legal subsets (case law, statutes, regs), (2) prefer per-channel quant for domain models with structured rare tokens, (3) add bench to emit per-subset R@k, purity, and top1-top2 gap.
jordy: also add an automated canary: fail int6 builds if any subset's R@10 drops >0.03 or purity drops >0.12 vs fp16.
claire: will open PR with checklist edits and bench flags, and attach artifacts + UMAPs in the ticket LEGAL-EMB-1287.
ops-bot: ticket LEGAL-EMB-1287 created and assigned to claire; artifacts stored at /artifacts/6461200*
hamid: nice catch. legal language quirks keep showing up as tail effects. cheers :thumbsup:
